mentions.description: A daily newsletter that features cool, random stuff from across the internet, aiming to recreate the magic of the original StumbleUpon by surfacing interesting sites and content.
mentions.problem: Interesting old-web content is buried under a mountain of low-quality material online, making it hard to discover.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I started a newsletter that tries to recreate the original magic of stumble upon. To feature cool random stuff from across the internet.

I believe the old internet is still alive and well. It's just buried under a mountain of shit.
